reference.scope: User supplied checked text or meaning. It includes fragmentary start/end and has not been adjudicated as a complete verbatim reference. Raw wording remains private.

input.selection: Only the first preselected blind window, after an independently supplied user listening reference. Reference never sent in inference prompts.

methods.decoding: greedy, max_new_tokens=448; automatic language, no hints
greedy, max_new_tokens=400; automatic source language, diagnostic confidence thresholds disabled, no prior-window context

metrics.strict_policy: Case-fold and remove non-word/non-whitespace punctuation except apostrophes, then whitespace split.
metrics.reference_status: User-listened, partly unclear and fragmentary; diagnostic only. No full-window accuracy gate decision.
metrics.normalizer_postprocessing: Remove normalized tokens with no alphanumeric character, identically on reference and hypotheses. The English normalizer left a standalone period from the trailing ellipsis; it is annotation/punctuation, not a spoken word.
metrics.postprocessing_timing: Discovered after initial scores. Raw scores retained and both reported; no acceptance decision.

semantic_review.method: Agent comparison of candidate text with user reference, not independent audio listening.
semantic_review.qwen: Close textual match; tentative implementation and negation preserved. Initial reference fragment omitted, grammar changed and extra tokens present. No unqualified critical-error pass.
semantic_review.hy: Improves fluency but changes a singular technical-looking term to plural ordinary noun. This is a term-fidelity regression relative to its input; interpretation of the intended tool requires listener confirmation. Tentative implementation and negation retained.
semantic_review.whisper: Recognition and direct translation outputs are identical on this English window. More omitted wording; no evidence about Hindi translation from this case.
semantic_review.boundary_warning: Both recognizers complete a word beyond the reference ending. The user left that ending fragmentary, so this is unresolved, not a confirmed hallucination. Keep the original reference and scores without post-hoc exclusions.
semantic_review.critical_error_gate: Not adjudicated. No mixed-language acceptance result.

decision.interpretation: Qwen scores better on this one English sample. This does not select a Hindi-English pipeline or validate the renderer.
decision.next: Collect a checked Hindi-English source and English meaning, resolve critical terms and boundary uncertainty, then evaluate representative coverage.
